CREATE TRIGGER `imc_schedule_teamid_gw011_bi` BEFORE INSERT ON `IMC005_Schedule` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.home_sm_team_id=IF(NEW.home_sm_team_id IS NULL OR NEW.home_sm_team_id=0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT z.team_id)=1 THEN MIN(z.team_id) ELSE NULL END FROM (SELECT home_name team_name,home_sm_club_id team_id FROM GW011_IMC_Results UNION ALL SELECT away_name,away_sm_club_id FROM GW011_IMC_Results) z WHERE z.team_id IS NOT NULL AND z.team_id<>0 AND LOWER(TRIM(z.team_name))=LOWER(TRIM(NEW.home_name))),NEW.home_sm_team_id),NEW.home_sm_team_id), NEW.away_sm_team_id=IF(NEW.away_sm_team_id IS NULL OR NEW.away_sm_team_id=0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT z.team_id)=1 THEN MIN(z.team_id) ELSE NULL END FROM (SELECT home_name team_name,home_sm_club_id team_id FROM GW011_IMC_Results UNION ALL SELECT away_name,away_sm_club_id FROM GW011_IMC_Results) z WHERE z.team_id IS NOT NULL AND z.team_id<>0 AND LOWER(TRIM(z.team_name))=LOWER(TRIM(NEW.away_name))),NEW.away_sm_team_id),NEW.away_sm_team_id)
